messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — Elevated 5xx + timeouts for model-runner pool 'mr-prod-us-west-2'. Route: POST /v1/generate. Error rate jumped to ~18% at ~2951012300. Paging @dave (oncall). Severity: Sev2.

 dave (oncall): ack — looking. assigning eng-runtime + eng-sre. grabbing logs now.

 maria (eng-runtime): I'm on it. initial check: multiple runner pods are restarting. seeing OOM/segfault patterns in the logs. attaching snippets.

 jess (eng-sre): any autoscale activity? did we get node evictions?

 alex (infra): autoscaler kicked +2 replicas 2951012350 but pods kept failing. no recent infra deploys. PS: kube events show CrashLoopBackOff on model-runner-*.

 luis (support): Support ticket stream showing customers getting 502/504s, high latencies. Top impacted accounts: acme-inc, beta-apps. Notifying CS to keep customers updated.

 maria (eng-runtime): logs (trimmed):
```
[2951012338] model_runner: INFO  starting inference for request req=0x7f8a3c
[2951012340] model_runner: ERROR allocation failed: std::bad_alloc
[2951012341] kernel: [12345.678901] Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (model_runner) total-vm:64g anon-rss:58g
[2951012342] model_runner: SIGSEGV at 0x7ffdeadbeef, pc=0x55aaeeff
```

 jess (eng-sre): looks like large allocations causing OOM then segfaults on resume. Do we have corresponding core dumps?

 maria (eng-runtime): found core dump uploaded to /var/crash/core.model_runner. grabbing minimal bt:
```
#0  0x000055aaeeff in model::generate(...)
#1  0x000055aaf200 in runner::process_request(...)
#2  0x00007f8b1234 in start_thread
```

 alex (infra): node-level metrics: GPU mem pressure high, host RAM at 92% on node mr-node-07. kube-eviction threshold hit.

 jess (eng-sre): immediate mitigations we can do: 1) disable large-batch inference (turn off dynamic batching), 2) route traffic to fallback quantized model (mr-small-q8) 3) drain worst nodes and force restart of runners. Maria, can you toggle batching?

 maria (eng-runtime): disabling dynamic batching on mr-prod config now. patch applied at 2951012410.

 incident-bot: ACTION — routing fallback enabled to model variant 'mr-small-q8' (config change id cfg-2026-03-15-011).

 luis (support): after fallback routing went live, customer error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% within 3m but some requests still 5xx. informing top customers.

 maria (eng-runtime): rolling restart of model-runner pods started 2951012455; draining node mr-node-07 flagged for manual repro. Collecting full core dumps and perf traces.

 jess (eng-sre): temporary autoscale bump approved: +4 replicas across us-west-2, 2951012470. Note: will increase cost but buys headroom.

 maria (eng-runtime): observed one node with corrupted shared memory segment — suspect kernel OOM + heap corruption happening under high memory pressure. reproducer attempts on test cluster show similar OOM when input length + batch > threshold.

 alex (infra): isolating nodes with GPU memory leaks. marking mr-node-07 as cordoned 2951012500. manual repro scheduled in staging.

 jess (eng-sre): monitoring: p50 latency stable, p95 still elevated. currently error rate 3.1%.

 luis (support): CS sent interim message to affected customers, offering status update and follow-up.

 maria (eng-runtime): short-term mitigation implemented: permanently route 30% traffic to mr-small-q8 until fix verified; disable heavy prompt pre-tokenization for large requests.

 incident-bot: UPDATE — Error rate now 2.8% (2951012630). Degraded but largely mitigated.

 dave (oncall): handing off live incident to @maria (primary) for full remediation and postmortem. Handoff notes:
- root cause suspected: memory growth/unbounded allocation in quantized attention path under certain prompt shapes -> leads to SIGSEGV/OOM on host.
- mitigation executed: disable dynamic batching, enable fallback routing to mr-small-q8, restarted pods, cordoned bad node, autoscale bump.
- customer impact: intermittent 5xx and timeouts for ~45m window; top customers notified; CS ticket #TCK-9042 created.

 maria (eng-runtime): taking post-incident lead. next steps: 1) capture full reproducer and fix quantized attention allocator, 2) add pre-check to reject overly large batch+seq combos, 3) add runbook step to auto-fallback to mr-small-q8 on OOM spike.

 postmortem-bot: ACTION — postmortem template created and assigned to maria (due in 72h).

 jess (eng-sre): quick followups: tune p95 CPU/GPU mem alert to lower threshold; add alert for consecutive CrashLoopBackOff count >3; add graceful-restart backoff to runner.

 alex (infra): prepping kernel and container runtime logs for SRE review; will upload to incident artifact store.

 luis (support): final note: customers mostly back to normal, one large customer requested detailed timeline and mitigation notes. I'll coordinate with Maria for whitebox.

 maria (eng-runtime): mitigated for now. keeping thread open for postmortem items. closing on-call handover to night-shift.

 dave (oncall): thanks all.
